name: Horizon Europe: Living labs co-creating solutions for the restoration of ecosystems
summary: Horizon Europe funding for consortia that set up living labs of 8 to 15 restoration sites each, co-creating and testing ways past the bottlenecks to restoring rivers, floodplains, fire-prone land, farms and forests under the EU Nature Restoration Regulation.

geography.label: Living labs in at least three EU Member States and/or Horizon Europe Associated Countries

amount.note: Around EUR 10 million per project; proposals may request other amounts

reporting: Consortia submit a periodic report for each reporting period, tied to interim payments, and a final report at the end of the project that sets the final grant amount.

status.quote: The submission session is now available for: HORIZON-NATURE-2027-02-02

pool.quote: Indicative budget The total indicative budget for the topic is EUR 60.00 million.

applicant_types.quote: Any legal entity, regardless of its place of establishment

geography.quote: cover different geographical regions or climate zones and at least three different EU Member States and/or Associated Countries, including sites in outermost regions

access.quote: All proposals must be submitted electronically via the EU Funders & Tenders Portal electronic submission system (accessible via the topic page in the Search Funding & Tenders section).

amount.quote: The Commission estimates that an EU contribution of around EUR 10.00 million would allow these outcomes to be addressed appropriately. Nonetheless, this does not preclude submission and selection of a proposal requesting different amounts.

co_finance_required.quote: The maximum Horizon Europe funding rates are as follows: - Research and innovation action: 100%

consortium_required.quote: only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country

reporting.quote: There will be one or several interim payments linked to a periodic report, depending on the duration of the project. At the end of the project, the consortium will be invited to submit a report on the basis of which the final grant amount will be calculated.
